passiveEffects.name: Overgrow
passiveEffects.originalDescription: The user heals an additional 10% of the healing value to allies or themself while that target is at or below 30% HP.
passiveEffects.summary: The user heals an additional 10% of the healing value to allies or themself while that target is at or below 30% HP.

moveEffects.name: Magical Leaf
moveEffects.originalDescription: The user scatters curious leaves at a designated target, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 40% for 2s.

moveEffects.name: Synthesis
moveEffects.originalDescription: The user photosynthesizes and produces energy around the designated ally and the user for 1s. Allies in the area of effect get healed, if within both circles of energy the second circle's healing is halved, while opposing Pokémon have their damage lowered by 15% for 3s.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Full Bloom Aroma
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user emits a sweet aroma around themselves dealing damage to opposing Pokémon every 0.5s up to 10 times. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move have their damage reduced by 10% for 3s, the duration is refreshed on each hit. For up to 5s, the user's next move will be in full bloom, granting extra effects. Meganium gains 2700 energy per second instead of the usual 900. Hitting with moves grants 4500 energy. Unite buffs: 10% Movement Speed, 10% Max HP Shield
